cause: Categorical expansion rejected a same-named existing indicator without checking whether its values exactly represented the requested non-reference level.
impact: A valid fixed-effect workflow can fail before fitting when a dataset contains durable precomputed indicators alongside the source categorical column.
lesson: Name equality is insufficient for model-term reuse. A persisted indicator may be reused only after an exact finite value comparison against the server-derived contrast; otherwise the workflow must fail closed.

evidence.ref: CE4 visible workflow log reported categorical dummy collision; tests/test_model_terms.py reproduced equivalent and non-equivalent indicator cases
